notes: CURRENT RELEASE: v2026.916.1-isol8.4 (fork PR #27, branch isol8/2026.916-rebase, merge 04f2b5d8d; GHCR digest above). WHAT CHANGED vs isol8.3: deleting a goal or project returned 502 (SQLSTATE 23503) whenever any task, cost or finance row still pointed at it. goalService.remove / projectService.remove now null those references (issues, projects.goal_id, cost_events, finance_events; sub-goals re-parent to the deleted goal's parent) and delete in one transaction. No migration, no env change. NOTE: GitHub paused Actions on the public fork for usage on 2026-10-13; a maintainer re-enabled it from the fork's Actions page before this build. PREVIOUS: CURRENT RELEASE: v2026.916.1-isol8.3 (fork PR #26, branch isol8/2026.916-rebase, merge c6f5a4d2e; GHCR digest above). WHAT CHANGED vs isol8.2: upstream's cross-issue influence limiter (#10837) refused every run-less agent write, including comments/PATCHes on the agent's OWN assigned issue from a Lightbulb room turn, and every write from a plain timer heartbeat (tickTimers gives the run no issueId and checkout never recorded the claimed issue) -- 85 prod refusals 09-24..09-27. Now: a run-less assignee may write its own issue unless a live run holds the lock (issues.hasLiveRunLock); issueService.checkout records the claimed issueId onto heartbeat_runs.context_snapshot when the run has no source issue. No migration, no env change. PREVIOUS: CURRENT RELEASE: v2026.916.1-isol8.2 (fork PR #25, branch isol8/2026.916-rebase, commit 8663fb337; GHCR digest above). It replays the isol8 stack onto upstream paperclipai/paperclip v2026.916.1 (839 upstream commits past the 813 base). WHY: upstream fixed the two mechanics behind the 09-23 incidents. (1) The orphan reaper is lease-based and safe across rolling deploys (dbf5ea432d, migration 0273), so a deploy no longer reaps in-flight runs. (2) Exhausted recovery escalates to the BOARD and keeps the assignee (f572e08678, policy board_escalation_no_takeover_v1). Owner ruling 2026-09-24: Paperclip owns escalation and Lightbulb #3079 is retired once the recovery-action card is ported. UPSTREAM SEMANTICS TO KNOW: setup_failed is non-retryable and blocks on the FIRST failure; process_lost gets 1 retry; timeout gets up to 3. LIGHTBULB LOCKSTEP (same PR as this bump): upstream 54dd0f4868 made new agents hire-capable by default. Our PAPERCLIP_REQUIRE_GOVERNED_AGENT_CREATION env var was never read by any fork release (fork PR #21 closed as superseded), so PaperclipAdminClient's agent create now always sends canCreateAgents=false unless a caller overrides it explicitly. Interactions default to resolverPolicy 'anyone' (10d0555189), so human confirmations pass human_only. No new env is needed. TRUST_PROXY is unnecessary because PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL is always a trusted origin and both the BFF and the proxy stamp a matching Origin. Better Auth 0230 applies on boot via PAPERCLIP_MIGRATION_AUTO_APPLY. A bad agent bearer now 401s, but agent keys go microVM->Paperclip and never through the BFF's 401 session re-mint. PAPERCLIP_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY and PAPERCLIP_DECISION_SIGNING_SECRET are still read from env and already supplied (paperclip-stack.ts). MIGRATIONS / ROLL FORWARD ONLY: first boot applies 64 upstream migrations. Fork migrations 0216-0218 are renumbered byte-identical to 0280-0282, so Paperclip's hash-based migrator (packages/db/src/client.ts loadAppliedMigrations) resolves them as already applied on existing DBs. 0283 is new: it generalises agent_create_idempotency_keys (operation/scope/resource_id columns) for the company, routine and API-key creates. An upgrade test builds an isol8.6-shaped DB. Do not roll back to .6 after the schema has moved; take an Aurora snapshot before the prod promote. CARRIED fork patches (real source): routine circuit breaker + routine.auto_paused plugin event; agent-delete full agents.id FK sweep; FK-safe company delete (COMPANY_DELETE_SEQUENCE, extended for upstream's new tables); issue-delete child cleanup; budget-policy orphan sweep + read-path skip; orphan-blocker self-delegation guard; accepted-interaction requeue backoff; daily-cap retry parking; PAPERCLIP_SKIP_BUILTIN_AGENTS gate; bundled isol8-notifications forwarder (issue.thread_interaction_created, approvals, agent.run.finished/failed, routine.auto_paused -> backend /webhooks/paperclip-events); webhook trigger auth hardening + caller secrets + hmac_sha1; routine reviewers (executionPolicy); Idempotency-Key on agent, company, routine and agent API-key creates (replay-only never rotates a key); issue-prefix re-derive on empty-board rename; agent-comment whitespace fix; non-UUID X-Paperclip-Run-Id 400 guard. DROPPED: all openclaw-gateway patches (Lightbulb runs hermes_gateway only; that adapter now equals upstream), the productivity-review stale sweep (upstream removed automatic reviews, 3bafac12f), and the openclaw run-log text patch. ROLLBACK REFS (unmoved): tag v2026.813-isol8.6 / branch isol8/2026.813-circuit-breaker; tag v2026.916.1-isol8.1 is the pre-cleanup replay. Releases are cut from TAGS. Fork PR #25's `policy` check (block manual lockfile edits) cannot pass on a sync PR against fork master; the tag's frozen-lockfile build is the gate. PROCESS: `upstream` is the fork GHCR image pinned by digest; `upstreamCommit` is the FORK commit and drives the extended ECR tag. Merging a bump here runs build-paperclip-image.yml (a thin re-tag into ECR `extendedImage` so ECS can pull with execution-role creds); its tag then goes into `dev.tag` (validate) and `prod.tag` (promote) in follow-up PRs.
